source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_APPENDIX::U01: Navigate IT law without treating an obsolete index as operative text

payload.title: A section index needs legal-status reconciliation
payload.core_explanation_md:
Use the IT index to separate electronic recognition,signature/certificate rules,subscriber duties,contraventions,offences,protected systems and intermediary questions. Identify the specific record or conduct before selecting a provision. A valid signature and a lawful authorised transaction remain different questions.

An old index can retain an obsolete or struck-down heading,such as the66A listing that requires explicit legal-status reconciliation. Do not create a present-law offence question merely because the heading appears. Schedule amendments and staggered DPDP-related changes also require version evidence. The final source scan is duplicated; it does not create an extra syllabus topic or a second statutory provision.

self_check.prompt_text: Does an old index establish that every listed offence remains enforceable?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Verify the operative text,amendments and judicial status.

Assume every IT provision is invalid
